$comment: Mega cheat-sheet poster (lead magnet: feed version is deliberately small, full-res PNG/PDF sent on 'comment SEO'). Three SEO jobs as typed decisions vs code vs human. Link criteria from ~/.claude/skills/che-linkbuilding (concepts only, its numeric ranges are unsourced so none are printed). Jev constraints from TypeSafe docs jev-1.13 (not a calculator, dates read as text). No figures on the card.
title: SEO decisions, *typed.*
sub: Links, keywords, content audits. What a model should decide, what code should count, what a person should see.

legend.typed: ask a typed-decision model. Closed options, abstain in green
legend.code: compute first. Numbers, dates, counts never go to the model
legend.human: the abstain queue. A person works it

sections.label: BACKLINKS
sections.question: Take this link, or walk away?

cards.title: Is the linking page about our topic?
lines: State = page title, body excerpt, our topic list
Relevance beats authority on a new site

cards.title: Where does the link sit?
lines: A link inside the argument is worth more than one in the bio

cards.title: Does the site look like a link seller?
lines: Feed it the outbound link list and the homepage text

cards.title: Authority, traffic, velocity, anchor mix
lines: Domain rank and real traffic from your API
New linking domains per month
Exact-match anchor share across the profile

cards.title: Paid, borderline, or UNRESOLVED
lines: Money and reputation risk. A person signs off

sections.label: KEYWORDS
sections.question: New page, or an existing one?

cards.title: What does the searcher want?
lines: State = keyword plus the top results' titles
mixed is a real answer, not a failure

cards.title: Do two keywords share a SERP?
lines: Count shared URLs in the top ten
Overlap is arithmetic. Compute it, then ask

cards.title: Which page owns it?
lines: Candidates from Search Console, built in code
The model picks, never invents a URL

cards.title: What page type does it need?
lines: Match the format that already ranks

cards.title: new_page or UNRESOLVED
lines: A new URL is a commitment. A person decides

sections.label: CONTENT AUDIT
sections.question: Leave it, fix it, merge it, kill it?

cards.title: Traffic trend and page age
lines: Clicks now vs a year ago
Last-updated date. The model reads dates as text

cards.title: Is the page still accurate?
lines: State = page text plus your current facts sheet
No confidence field. Treat it as a lean

cards.title: What should happen to it?
lines: Hand it the numbers you computed, as words

cards.title: Merge into which page?
lines: Candidates from your own internal-link graph

cards.title: Every redirect and UNRESOLVED
lines: A redirect is hard to undo. A person approves
